about_the_game:
Jump into the world of HORA with this free demo.

Experience the core gameplay: explore procedurally generated levels, close vents, loot contaminated items, dodge deadly traps, and survive unique enemy encounters — solo

Try out upgrades, sector progression, and chaotic tools... all without needing to go online.

Twitch integration and online co-op are not available in this demo — but the danger is very real.

Type READY. Step into the elevator. And good luck — you'll need it.
